thread:
maya-cs: Quick sync — HarrowSight onboarding health. Renewal risk flag popped (usage up but tail latency hiccups). p95 chat gen ~420ms, p99 spikes to ~1.1s during bursts. Customer is sensitive to latency for their realtime agent. Thinking proactive play: int8 quant can reduce token latency and cost, plus a regional routing split (EU -> dedicated, fallback -> hosted) and prefix KV caching for common instructions. Want to run a small canary and get SE enablement scheduled. 

devon-ml: +1. I ran a profiling pass on their traces. Hot spots are self-attention kernel + KV memcpy on long-chats. Int8 reduces kernel time ~18% in our bench for this model family. Also suggest swapping to the compact-v2 variant for lower memory bandwidth.

sam-platform: Routing concern: their traffic is 65% EU, 35% US. We should create a routing rule: route by geo -> dedicated EU pool with reserved capacity, then fallback to hosted EU, then hosted global. Also set a circuit-breaker if p95 > 800ms to route to smaller compact model.

alex-se: Customer contact (Vivian) worried about hallucination after quant. Recommend an evaluation set of 200 highest-impact prompts from their prod samples. We'll diff logits/outputs and set a rollback threshold: >3% drop in answer-accuracy triggers rollback.

maya-cs: Proposed canary plan: 1) 1% traffic -> int8+compact-v2 in EU dedicated for 2h, 2) run eval set, 3) compare lat/cost/accuracy, 4) expand to 10% then 50%. Owners: devon-ml (canary config), sam-platform (routing), alex-se (evals), me (customer comms).

devon-ml: Canary config snippet (for ops):
```yaml
model: compact-v2
quantization: int8
caching:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 900
batching:
  max_tokens: 512
  max_batch_size: 16
routing_policy:
  primary: dedicated-eu
  fallback_order: [hosted-eu, hosted-global]
  latency_circuit_breaker: 800 # ms p95
```

sam-platform: I'll add the routing rule and reserved pool. Note: need a quota bump for dedicated-eu for the canary window — requesting +2 vGPUs for 3h.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: jobs/harrowsight-canary-3170005555 queued by devon-ml. Link: https://console.redwood/jobs/3170005555 

alex-se: For the evaluation, I'll pull 200 prompts now and run locally vs baseline. Suggest using our eval harness: `tools/eval/run --customer harrowsight --set canary-3170005555 --threshold 0.03`

vivian-customer: Thanks team! Appreciate the proactive push. Please keep us in the loop on any config that might change result style. We'll share a quick list of 12 critical utterances to prioritize.

maya-cs: Next steps: devon -> push canary config, sam -> reserve pool & routing, alex -> eval diff and report within 3h, maya -> coord call with Vivian at end of canary. I'll capture feedback in the renewal risk tracker. :white_check_mark:

devon-ml: Noted. I'll also capture latency traces and KV hit-rate metrics and post summary in this thread when canary completes.

sam-platform: Quota bumped +2 vGPUs for 3h. Routing rule staged and gated by circuit-breaker.

maya-cs: Closing loop — thanks all. If eval shows >3% degradation, we auto-rollback to baseline and notify customer. Otherwise proceed to gradual ramp.
